    noncomputable def ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.corrWordBimodFiber {X : Type v} {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (E0 : X → CorrEndBimod H H) (D0 : CorrTensorTailEndData (vacuumFiber H)) (D : (x : X) → (M : CorrWordBimod H) → FuseWordBoundaryData (E0 x) M) :
    List X → CorrWordBimod H

    Right-recursive reduced-word bimodule fiber. The empty word is H with its committed trailing End H boundary, and a nonempty word is formed by the boundary-preserving fusion with the already-threaded tail bimodule.
